messages:
rita (releases): Quick alert — nightly canary in us-east showed intermittent incompat between runtime 2.17.0 and model family fast-q. Proposal: perform a hybrid pin (runtime+model routing) for a tiny cohort while we triage. Keeping blast radius tiny.

samir (runtime): saw the mismatch logs. Not a full regression, but there are increased tail latencies when runtime + fast-q hit a specific vnode. Hybrid pin makes sense: route fast-q -> fast-q-stable on canary and pin runtime->2.16.9 for that cohort.

claire (sdk): FYI SDKs are compatible; only default routing changes. We should add `X-Fallback-Reason: hybrid-pin` header on responses so customers can see it.

ops-lee: Operational asks: reserve +12% capacity, schedule during 04:00-08:00 UTC. Suggest start at 04:15 UTC and keep duration 2h for quick triage.

sre-hope: Telemetry owners: set abort if 99p latency > 2x baseline or error_rate delta > 0.05%. I'll wire an auto-abort hook to the runbook.

deploy-bot: Automated suggestion: `pin runtime 2.16.9 --region us-east-1 --cohort canary-tiny --duration 2h` and `pin model fast-q --to fast-q-stable --cohort canary-tiny --region us-east-1`. Pre/post metric diff attached.

rita (releases): Runbook snippet for quick copy:
```bash
# hybrid pin for tiny canary
# 1) pin runtime for cohort
deploybot pin runtime 2.16.9 --region us-east-1 --cohort canary-tiny --duration 2h --drain-delay 60s
# 2) route model to stable variant
deploybot pin model fast-q --to fast-q-stable --region us-east-1 --cohort canary-tiny --duration 2h
# rollback: deploybot unpin runtime 2.16.9 && deploybot unpin model fast-q --reason "auto-abort"
```

samir (runtime): I'll enable binding-trace for that cohort for 30m after pin to collect samples.

claire (sdk): I'll add header flag and draft a one-line note in release-notes/drafts.

sre-hope: Alerts set. Auto-abort will also page oncall if thresholds breach.

ops-lee: Capacity buffer +12% added. network route checks pass.

rita (releases): Approvals needed: @samir, @claire, @sre-hope. Please react with :white_check_mark:.

samir (runtime): :white_check_mark:

claire (sdk): :white_check_mark:

sre-hope: :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Action scheduled: hybrid pin at 04:15 UTC (us-east-1, cohort: canary-tiny). Will post metric snapshot at 04:45 UTC.

rita (releases): Thanks team — we'll reconvene at 05:00 UTC to decide rollforward vs rollback. If anything unexpected, call #incidents and abort. :rocket:
